defense_contracts.raw_text: Raytheon Co., Woburn, Massachusetts is being awarded a contract modification (P00038) under a previously awarded indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract HQ0147-18-D-0001. This modification provides for a non-competitive, two-year extension and increases the contract ceiling from $2,605,033,000 to $2,999,033,000. The current contract was the result of a sole-source acquisition. Under this contract extension, Raytheon will continue operations and sustainment support for the Army Navy/Transportable Radar Surveillance and Control Model 2 (AN/TPY-2) radar systems, utilizing a combination of cost-plus-incentive-fee, cost-plus-fixed-fee, and firm-fixed-price contract line items. Associated task order extensions reflecting the increase are also being awarded. The work will be performed in Woburn, Massachusetts, and at multiple radar sites inside and outside of the continental U.S. The contract modification will extend the current ordering period an additional two years from Oct. 31, 2026, to Oct. 31, 2028. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance, research, development, test and evaluation, and procurement funds totaling $112,309,403 will be obligated at the time of award via task order modification. The Missile Defense Agency, Redstone Arsenal, Alabama, is the contracting activity.

Enlighten IT Consulting LLC, Columbia, Maryland, has been awarded a $332,830,519 firm-fixed-price contract under a Commercial Solutions Opening via the Tradewinds Solutions Marketplace (TSM). This contract provides for an enterprise service solution that is critical in establishing interoperability with Joint Cyber Warfighting Architecture Common Runtime Stack for Data edge analytics, storage, and data transport capabilities within the Integrated Defensive Cyber System architecture. Work will be performed within and outside the continental United States and is expected to be completed by Sept. 30, 2032. This contract was a competitive acquisition via the TSM, and seven offers were received. Fiscal 2026 Air Force operations and maintenance funds; Air Force research, development, test and evaluation funds; Space Force research, development, test and evaluation funds; and Space Force operations and maintenance funds, are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Joint Base San Antonio, Texas, is the contracting activity (FA8307-26-C-B015). (Awarded on Sept. 30, 2026).
